title: Elf Bar JoinOne Strawberry Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Ice blends juicy, sun-ripened Strawberry with a crisp Menthol chill for a bright, refreshing vape. The fruit leads with soft, summery sweetness, while the cooling layer adds a frosty edge that sharpens the flavour and keeps it lively. Each JoinOne Prefilled Pod + Refill arrives ready to use with 2ml pod and 10ml refill container of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and an integrated dual-mesh coil for consistent flavour delivery. Simply assemble then slide into the Mini Battery and snap it onto the larger battery (the one with the HD Screen) adjust the kit’s airflow to suit a tighter or looser mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw. When the pod is empty, simply replace it with a fresh one — no refilling or coil changes required. This pod keeps maintenance simple while offering clean, flavour in a compact format.
